title: Spanish Lentil Soup with Shipka Pepper Salsa
subtitle: with lemon and coriander
description: A rich black lentil soup built on slowly softened vegetables, served with a fresh salsa of chopped green peppers, lemon zest and coriander.

steps.text: Dice the onions, carrots and celery stalks and crush the garlic. Rinse the lentils after soaking them in water for at least 1 hour.

Heat olive oil in a pot and gently cook the vegetables and garlic over low heat until soft, without letting them brown. This is the most important step: the longer the vegetables cook on low heat, the more flavour they release into the soup.
Add the lentils, vegetable stock, rosemary sprig, salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook covered until the lentils are tender. Remove the rosemary.
For the salsa, deseed and dice the green peppers and mix with the zest of 2 lemons, the juice of 1 or 2 lemons, 3 tablespoons olive oil and the chopped coriander.
Bring the soup back to the boil, ladle into bowls and top each with a spoonful of salsa.
